Name: Account Management
Finding: 2 of 4 terminated users (U1003, U1010) were still Active. 2 of 14 active users (U1010, U1016) were past the six-month review cycle.

Name: Personnel Termination
Finding: Terminations on 2026-05-15 and 2026-06-02 had not resulted in disabled accounts by 2026-06-15, well past the 24 hour requirement.

Name: Separation of Duties
Finding: User U1016 holds AP Clerk and Purchasing Agent, so one person can create a purchase order and process its payment. No compensating review found.

Name: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users)
Finding: Remote access over VPN does not require multi-factor authentication.

Name: Configuration Change Control
Finding: 4 of 8 changes failed: CH-2203 and CH-2207 had no approver, CH-2206 was approved after implementation, CH-2208 was self-approved.

Name: Contingency Plan Testing
Finding: A full restoration test of the financial database was completed and documented. Scope was restoration only; exercises of the wider plan were not evidenced (observation, not a finding).

Name: Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning
Finding: Scans run monthly and identified a critical ERP vulnerability, which shows the monitoring works. Remediation is assessed under SI-2.

Name: Flaw Remediation
Finding: A critical vulnerability on the production ERP application server remains unpatched past the 30 day requirement.

Name: Protection of Information at Rest
Finding: Payroll data was found in unencrypted spreadsheets on a shared drive.

Name: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting
Finding: Log review is done with an ad hoc script on exported logs. There is no weekly review record or alerting.

Name: Incident Response Plan
Finding: No tested runbook exists for ransomware, the most likely high-impact incident for this system.

Name: Literacy Training and Awareness
Finding: Training material exists and covers phishing and malware with reporting steps. Completion and phishing simulation metrics were not available (observation).
